item.title: NPSO partners with community organizations to provide Christmas care baskets
item.description: The Natchitoches Parish Sheriff’s Office, in partnership with Cane River Charities and the Marthaville Seventh Day Adventist Church, came together this holiday season to assemble and distribute Christmas Care baskets to families in need throughout Natchitoches Parish. This collaborative effort reflects a shared commitment to supporting local families and spreading hope during the Christmas season. … Continue reading NPSO partners with community organizations to provide Christmas care baskets

item.title: Natchitoches Junior High 8th grade JAG students give back to community
item.description: Natchitoches Junior High School’s 8th grade JAG (Jobs for America’s Graduates) students recently demonstrated leadership and community spirit by volunteering at the Food Bank of Central Louisiana. Working together, the students bagged an impressive 8,599 pounds of sweet potatoes to support local families in need. item.title: Christmas brings out the kid in all of us
item.description: There’s something magical about experiencing Christmas through the eyes of a child who still believes in Saint Nick. It brings excitement and anticipation of what he’ll leave under the tree on Christmas morning. But no matter how old you are, there’s still something magical about Christmas morning. item.title: Lady Demons’ Valentine collects SLC honor
item.description: For the third time in seven weeks, a Northwestern State women’s basketball standout has claimed the Southland Conference Player of the Week honor. After sophomore Vernell Atamah won it twice, newcomer Nya Valentine was this week’s recipient. Valentine, a graduate student from Mobile, Ala., helped lead the Demons to a pair of big wins this past week at McNeese and at home against Lamar, two … Continue reading Lady Demons’ Valentine collects SLC honor

item.title: Parish of Natchitoches announces temporary pause in LIHEAP assistance
item.description: The Parish of Natchitoches Office of Community Services (OCS) has announced that LIHEAP (Low Income Home Energy Assistance Program) funds are currently unavailable.
